history.content: Tell me about the history of the bicycle.

The bicycle has a long history. Early designs in the 1810s had no pedals, and riders pushed themselves along with their feet. Pedals were added to the front wheel in the 1860s, and the safety bicycle with a chain drive and two equal wheels appeared in the 1880s, which made cycling popular around the world.
